title: Office 2016 Activation (Official Dell Tech Support)
description: Get help with Microsoft Office 2016 activation issues for your Dell computer. Link for the Office download go to www.office.com/myaccount Link for the Microsoft troubleshooting tool use http://aka.ms/diag_97275 If you have questions or need support, contact us through social media on Facebook at www.facebook.com/dell and Twitter at www.twitter.com/dellcares  You can also join in a chat on our Dell Community Forum at www.dell.com/community and click on Support Forums. To learn more about our Dell Community Forum check out http://dell.to/2tbhVvt For additional guidance with your PC's maintenance and troubleshooting visit http://dell.to/2te92S1

asr.full_text: Welcome to Dell Tech Support. In today's video, we'll show you how to resolve the main issues that occur when activating. Microsoft Office 2016. As of December 16, 2016, any computers bought from Dell have an Office Digital Key. This means that your Office Key is no longer delivered separately inside the packaging. It comes factory pre-installed on your PC. So how does the activation process work? When you turn on your computer for the first time with internet access, one of the first. Things that your computer will do is activate your Windows operational system. This happens automatically. This step is very important because the Windows activation is directly linked to the Office. Activation. Both keys are linked within your Microsoft account. To check if your Windows is activated, right click on the start button and select System. Look under the Basic Information for Windows Activation to see if it is activated. If it is not activated, you need to run the Windows Update to conclude the Operation System. Activation process. If it is activated, you can begin the Office Activation process. First, confirm that Office 2016 is installed on your computer. In the search bar, type any of the Office programs, like Word or Excel, for example. If you do have Office, skip ahead to the next part in this video. If it isn't installed, here's how to do it. In the description below, there are two links. One is for your Office download and the other is for the Microsoft tool that will help with. The installation. Download and install Office and after it's complete, install and run the Microsoft tool. Now open any of the Office apps and a screen saying Let's Start will appear. Just follow the instructions to install Office as normal. If at the end of this installation you notice that the Office version that you activated. Is different than what you have purchased, simply run the Office Update. Go to the Account menu and click on Office Update and wait. After the update is finished, the correct version will be installed. Whenever you have questions or need help, you can always contact us through social media. On Facebook or Twitter. Be sure to check out our other tips and tutorials on this channel, and don't forget to subscribe. Thanks for watching!
